contextIntro.heading: {name} – compare party positions in a chat
contextIntro.introWithDate: On {date}, {location} goes to the polls. On wahl.chat you can ask the parties your own questions – about rents, education, the climate, the economy or any other topic you care about. Instead of working your way through hundreds of pages of manifestos, you get an answer to exactly the question you asked.
contextIntro.introWithoutDate: Political decisions are coming up in {location}. On wahl.chat you can ask the parties your own questions – about rents, education, the climate, the economy or any other topic you care about. Instead of working your way through hundreds of pages of manifestos, you get an answer to exactly the question you asked.
contextIntro.parties: For the {name}, you can chat with {parties}. You can also select several parties at once and compare their positions on the same topic side by side.
contextIntro.sources: Every answer is backed by sources: wahl.chat quotes the passages from the election manifestos and party programmes the answer is based on, and you can read them in the original with one click. You can see which documents are behind them on the <link>sources page</link>.
contextIntro.wahlOMat: Unlike the Wahl-O-Mat, you don't respond to set statements. You decide what to talk about, and you can ask follow-up questions if an answer is too vague. The <link>guide</link> explains exactly how it works.
contextIntro.disclaimer: The answers are generated by artificial intelligence and are not official statements by the parties. Your messages are stored to generate the answers and to show you your chat history – you'll find the details in the <link>privacy policy</link>.
